name: Día de los Muertos Catrina makeup and costumes
what_it_is: Videos show people creating La Catrina / calavera sugar-skull looks — white face paint with red and black bone, flower and swirl details — plus elaborate Day of the Dead costumes, wigs and hats, often framed as Halloween makeup transformations and costume showcases. A few also show the looks worn out in public, such as being turned away at a theme park for the face paint.
